description: This file provides classes and utility functions for interacting with a filesystem abstraction layer within an Odoo module, including file handling, directory listing, path normalization, and file operations, with specific integration for Odoo's ORM and security models.

classes.name: file_wrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around StringIO for handling file data and saving it as an attachment in Odoo.

classes.name: content_wrapper
classes.description: A wrapper around StringIO for handling content objects in Odoo, with custom write processing.

classes.name: abstracted_fs
classes.description: A class providing filesystem abstraction methods, path normalization, directory and file operations, and integration with Odoo ORM and security.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the 'DMS' channel with error level.

methods.name: _get_month_name
methods.description: Returns the abbreviated month name for a given month number.

methods.name: _to_unicode
methods.description: Converts a byte string to unicode, trying utf-8, latin, or ascii encodings.

methods.name: _to_decode
methods.description: Encodes a string to utf-8 or latin, or decodes from ascii, with error handling.

methods.name: db_list
methods.description: Returns a list of database names that contain the 'document' module and are installed.

methods.name: ftpnorm
methods.description: Normalizes an FTP path to an absolute, web-style path.

methods.name: ftp2fs
methods.description: Converts an FTP path to a filesystem object using ORM.

methods.name: fs2ftp
methods.description: Converts a filesystem node to an FTP path string.

methods.name: validpath
methods.description: Checks if a path is within the user's root directory.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a file or content wrapper object for a given node and filename.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a file or content node for reading.

methods.name: mkstemp
methods.description: Placeholder for creating a temporary file; not yet implemented.

methods.name: chdir
methods.description: Changes the current working directory to a given path node.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a new directory node in the ORM.

methods.name: close_cr
methods.description: Closes a database cursor.

methods.name: get_cr
methods.description: Retrieves a database cursor and user ID for a given FTP path.

methods.name: listdir
methods.description: Lists directory contents, including databases or ORM nodes.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Removes a directory node if empty.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a file or attachment node.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames files or directories, updating ORM records accordingly.

methods.name: stat
methods.description: Returns file statistics for a node, mimicking os.stat.

methods.name: lstat
methods.description: Alias for stat.

methods.name: isfile
methods.description: Checks if a node is a file.

methods.name: islink
methods.description: Always returns False; symbolic links not supported.

methods.name: isdir
methods.description: Checks if a node is a directory.

methods.name: getsize
methods.description: Returns size of a file node.

methods.name: getmtime
methods.description: Returns last modified time of a node.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the canonical path (no symbolic links support).

methods.name: lexists
methods.description: Checks if a path exists.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Alias for lexists.

methods.name: glob1
methods.description: Returns matching filenames in a directory based on pattern.

methods.name: get_list_dir
methods.description: Returns directory listing in FTP LIST format.

methods.name: get_stat_dir
methods.description: Returns directory listing in STAT format, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: format_list
methods.description: Formats directory entries similar to UNIX ls -l.

methods.name: format_mlsx
methods.description: Formats directory entries for MLSD/MLST commands with facts.
